basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer | Production Systems & Data Infrastructure | AI Investor
basics.summary: Software engineer who builds the production infrastructure that trading and forecasting systems run on. At Beekeeper I owned architecture across five concurrent production systems (Kafka, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL) and ran observability (Grafana) and on-call for a platform used by 10M+ users, the discipline real-time execution and monitoring demands. I've mentored a team scaling high-frequency algorithmic trading systems in production, and I invest in the space myself: I hold a stake in Polymarket and think applying AI to prediction markets is worth building for. 13+ years shipping production software and the data pipelines that tame messy, heterogeneous real-world input, from LLM systems at scale to a vision pipeline that turns unstructured photos into structured data.

work.name: LumApps
work.summary: Owns AI transformation end-to-end, from production AI agent architecture to company-wide governance and sales enablement strategy. Reports directly to C-level on outcomes.
highlights: Led technical discovery through production: agent architecture, eval pipelines, agent tracing (LangSmith), tool-selection tuning, and cost-per-request instrumentation, with on-call for global production systems.

Designed AI Brain, a temporal knowledge graph on Graphiti and Neo4j that unifies 5+ silos (Salesforce, HubSpot, Pendo, conversation transcripts, product usage) into one time-aware memory every agent reads and writes, combining heterogeneous signals into a single queryable layer.
Built and deployed production multi-agent workflows on Python, LangGraph and Google ADK over GCP Vertex AI. 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, $1M forecast in quarterly revenue.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
work.summary: Technical lead who operates like a founding engineer, owning architecture and production reliability across concurrent systems used by millions.
highlights: Ran observability and on-call for global production systems (Grafana, Datadog, Logz.io): logs, metrics, dashboards, and alerting for performance, exposure, and operational integrity.
Owned architectural design across five concurrent production systems (Artifacts, Forms, Employee Referral, Templater, Manager Hub), robust and modular by design, not by accident.
Replaced $337K in annual vendor translation costs with an LLM pipeline built in 6 weeks (prototype to production). 12K+ assets translated, product team now iterates without external gatekeepers.
Architected Employee Referral System end-to-end. Became the platform's top revenue channel ($1.5M+ generated, $500K ARR). Designed for 99.99% SLA because customer trust is measured in uptime.

AI agents generate AND justify trading signals by fusing heterogeneous technical and news data, with explainability and evaluation built in: if the model can't explain the signal, it doesn't ship.

_jobApplication.jobDescription: G-20 Group is a cross-asset trading firm (delta-one and derivatives) hiring a Prediction Markets Quant Engineer to build research and trading infrastructure for prediction markets (event contracts) across venues: probabilistic models for event outcomes, mispricing detection, position sizing, and risk, translated into end-to-end systems (data, forecasting, execution, monitoring). Requirements: degree in quantitative finance, math, CS, statistics, or related; strong Python engineering with production systems and data engineering experience; solid statistics/probability/ML foundation (calibration, uncertainty, causal pitfalls, time-series); experience building and evaluating backtests (log loss/Brier, calibration); trading concepts (expected value, position sizing, risk budgeting, correlation, liquidity); clear communication about model assumptions and risk; comfort in a dynamic, startup-like environment. Preferred: forecasting/sports analytics/political modeling/event-driven trading experience; NLP for news/signals; prediction market mechanics (order books vs AMMs); SQL, Kafka, Airflow, cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure); Bayesian methods/probabilistic programming (Stan/PyMC); rigorous experimentation and model governance. Tech stack: Python, SQL, pandas/numpy/scipy, PyTorch/sklearn, Airflow/dbt, Kafka, Postgres/BigQuery, Docker/Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, Prometheus/Grafana/OpenTelemetry.
_jobApplication.notes: Same gap as EnzianLabs: no hands-on Bayesian methods, probabilistic programming (Stan/PyMC), backtesting, or prediction-market trading experience, not fabricated. Tailored around genuine strengths instead: production trading-adjacent infrastructure (Beekeeper Kafka/Kubernetes/PostgreSQL/Grafana observability and on-call), algorithmic trading exposure (Tenity/Opt Alpha HFT mentoring), real-time systems and automated safeguards (Dronistics flight control), data pipelines taming messy input (Proplab, Beekeeper LLM pipeline), and genuine domain conviction as a Polymarket investor who believes AI applied to prediction markets is a structural edge. This is a stretch application on the core quant-research requirement.
